ymolten.hook: Made from y- + molten. molten goes back to Proto-Germanic *multanaz.

firstUse.quote: The Freſhneſs of this Valley ſmote their Eye, And drew them ever and anon more nigh, 'Till cluſtering round th'Enchanter falſe they hung, Ymolten with his Syren Melody;
firstUse.source: 1748, James Thomson, “Canto I”, in The Castle of Indolence: […], London: […] A[ndrew] Millar, […], stanza VIII, page 5:
